articles.title: Hurricane Nolo Is Crawling Toward Hawaii — And That's the Problem
articles.summary: Hurricane Nolo is creeping toward Hawaii at just 5 mph. It probably won't hit land, but it could dump up to 2 feet of rain, and the Big Island is under a hurricane watch.

articles.title: A Giant Storm Soaks New York and New Jersey — Flights, Concerts, and Games Cancelled
articles.summary: A powerful nor'easter flooded New York and New Jersey on Saturday. More than 100,000 homes lost power, 2,400+ flights were delayed, and even Ed Sheeran's concert was cancelled.

articles.title: Trump Wants to Roll Back Fuel Rules — What Does That Mean for Cars?
articles.summary: President Trump announced new fuel economy standards that roll back Biden-era rules. He says it will lower car prices, but critics say it could slow the shift to electric vehicles.
